items.citation:
This step file produces a Laser Air Nozzle 43 mm Spindle Adapter, designed for use with engraving and cutting laser heads from Opt Lasers. In general, a lack of a directed airflow to the laser engraving or cutting site may cause a number of issues such as undesirable veins spreading from the site, randomized colour throughout the engravement, or a fluctuating cutting depth.  This nozzle helps to direct the airflow to avoid such issues. The original file is also available for download from the webpage:

https://optlasersgrav.com/ 

 

To learn more about the applications of the cutting and engraving laser heads from Opt Lasers that this nozzle was originally designed to work with, feel free to visit:

https://optlasersgrav.com/markets
